answer: The juniper graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the copper audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 6 times its size, so a group of 43 keys loses far more than 43 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the knoll checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
